facet_collection_not_canonical_rail.name: luxury-vip

recommended_structure: P0: solve the 5 currently empty rails
P1: top up high-demand thin rails, especially apparel/home/pets/travel/toys
P1-new: ask sourcing capability for missing product families before adding rails
Keep facets/collections out of supplier placement taxonomy
Furniture/office furniture must be compact/foldable where possible and quote-first by destination
Every supplied SKU still passes Placement -> Visual QA -> Variant/Stock -> Shipping -> Profit Truth
